package.description: EN 301 549 accessibility requirements package for ICT products and services.
package.author: ETSI

criteria.title: Non-text Content
criteria.desc: Web content requirements include text alternatives for non-text content consistent with WCAG mapping.
criteria.failures: Non-text content lacks equivalent text alternatives.
criteria.fixes: Provide equivalent text alternatives aligned with mapped WCAG requirements.

criteria.title: Keyboard
criteria.desc: Functionality must be operable through keyboard interfaces without requiring timing constraints.
criteria.fixes: Support complete keyboard access for required functions.

criteria.title: Name, Role, Value
criteria.desc: User interface components expose programmatically determinable name, role, and value.
criteria.failures: Custom controls do not expose accessible role/state.
criteria.fixes: Use semantic controls or complete ARIA role/state/value mappings.

criteria.title: User Preferences
criteria.desc: Software honors documented platform accessibility preference settings where available.
criteria.failures: Application ignores platform reduced motion, contrast, or input preferences.
criteria.fixes: Respect platform-level accessibility preferences and expose local controls.
